title: Treasure Box
subtitle: Among the dust and grass clippings lies a bright azure petal.

trails.title: Personal Notebook
trails.description: A notebook with elegant handwriting, accidentally left behind by someone.

content.text:
October 9, 19██
Ms. Sotheby seems to have lost some weight. The Foundation's diet is perhaps a bit monotonous ...

 Nuts & Cheese Crisp / Raspberry Protein Crisp Pudding
260g light cream, 45g sugar, 100g milk, 150g raspberry jam,
3 eggs, 1 vanilla pod, 15g gelatin sheets

October 16, 19██
Mission: Germany Branch
▪  Arcane Materials Catalog 
▪  Inventory of Remaining Arcane Goods 
▪  Inventory of Remaining Arcane Equipment 
▪  List of Senior Technical Personnels 

Contact: Ms. Mary Smith
New Identity: Nola Ward

November 5, 19██
Arrived at the branch. Is the number wrong?

There were some problems getting on board. Ms. Smith is missing, and my name is not in their HQ contact book.
The letter of introduction allayed some of their suspicions, but I still need to wait for the contact to confirm my identity with HQ.

[A letter clipped to the log book]
Ms. Moissan,
The list and reports have been received; thank you for your efforts. The number of missing persons is fifteen percent higher than we expected. I will report this and might need your assistance in investigating this matter with HQ.
I noticed Martin Moore is not on the list sent back this time. He is a top talent in the Germany Branch's drug research project, and I'm afraid we will need you to travel to Bavaria to find out the situation.
Z
From Foundation HQ

November 14, 19██
The German Branch can no longer provide aerial vehicles.

November 19, 19██
Ceramic workshop. I was probably only a few years old when I moved away ... but I still remember this spruce tree.

They didn't recognize me.

items.text: Treasure Box
Hold on, hold on!
It was a misunderstanding, Timekeeper. We attacked to defend ourselves. We are not the enemy!
The looming figures from the other side of the fog have their hands high in the air.

items.speaker: Female Investigator
items.text: We are the investigators from the Foundation. These are our IDs.
Ms. Moissan carefully takes their IDs and nods her head.

items.speaker: Lilya
items.text: The base has been deserted long ago, right? What's the purpose of the investigation now?

items.speaker: Female Investigator
items.text: The outside world has been reversed to 1913. We are here to collect the lost scientific devices from the 1970s.

items.speaker: Male Investigator
items.text: Science and technologies are regressing rapidly due to the "Storm." Those old devices, which used to be outdated, have become valuable to us.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: I see. Do you mind us investigating this place? It won't be long.

items.speaker: Female Investigator
items.text: Sure, we are glad to give you a hand if you need it, Timekeeper.

items.speaker: Ms. Moissan
items.text: Good. I have some questions about the base, and I wonder if you may help.
She quickly starts talking to the investigators, as if they have been long acquainted.

items.speaker: Regulus
items.text: Tsk, so it's just a mistake. Back to treasure hunting now?
Regulus swaggers into the base, inspecting the dusty boxes one by one.

items.speaker: Regulus
items.text: Let's see what Zeno and Laplace have left here.

items.speaker: Regulus
items.text: Infrared shotgun ... Maglev auto feeder ... K-tope Calibrator ... My God, and a full box of Laplace's military chocolate!

items.speaker: Regulus
items.text: Vertin! Come check it out! This is all good stuff! Solid MREs!

items.speaker: Regulus
items.text: Ahem, this Pirate with a heart of gold wouldn't mind tasting it for you.

items.speaker: Lilya
items.text: I don't mean to rain on your parade. But even dogs won't eat those things. It makes Olitiaus' excrement smell better in comparison.

items.speaker: APPLe
items.text: That being said, to the best of this APPLe's knowledge, canine animals shouldn't have consumed any food which contains theobromine anyhow.

items.speaker: Regulus
items.text: Emm. Then can I have it or not?

items.speaker: APPLe
items.text: There is nothing to be worried about since the Captain is not an animal of the Canidae family.

items.speaker: Regulus
items.text: Well said! As befits the first mate of mine!
Regulus happily lifts the small supply box that is placed on the chocolates.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: Wait a second, Regulus.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: Show me the thing in your arms.

items.speaker: Regulus
items.text: Why, what do you want? Feel like my chocolate now?

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: No, the supply box.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: It has my name on it.
Regulus lets out a gasp, and the wooden box in her hand lurches forward.

items.speaker: Regulus
items.text: Whoa, true!

items.speaker: Regulus
items.text: Are there any other "Vertin" in the Foundation?

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: As far as I know, no one is called by that name but me.
Lilya squints her eyes and knocks at the solid edge of the box.

items.speaker: Lilya
items.text: Looks like an ordinary wooden box. But these "ordinary" boxes are always the most dangerous.
Not far away from them, Ms. Moissan is still talking to the investigators and hasn't noticed what is happening here.

items.speaker: Regulus
items.text: Hmm. So, turns out we did find something useful in this treasure hunt?

items.speaker: Regulus
items.text: It even has Vertin's name on it, like a celebrity autograph. A treasure indeed!

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: Regulus, wait, don't …

items.speaker: Regulus
items.text: No one can stop a pirate from opening her fresh trophy!
Regulus immediately opens the box.
Her first glimpse is of a blue flower that stands out in the surroundings.
Then, she hears a bizarre static noise.
News of the day.

The outcasts held the 11,231st pep rally in the Mammoth Cave, Kentucky. They eventually unanimously passed the principle of "dozing in spring, relaxing in summer, slacking off in autumn, and hibernating in winter."

Practical Modern Incantations has now been reissued for the 77th time. We are now at the end of the 20th century. This book still remains the number one book on the list of "Most Regretful Purchase on Classic Score" by The New Yorker.
Biographer Urd has recently published her latest travel notes, Roaming in Apeiron, which has started a new round of craze for traveling in the Aegean Sea region.
The chief editor of Voice of the Millennium strongly recommends this book, praising it to be the literary reproduction of the romantic, elegant, and classical dreams, a glimpse at the Golden Era!
Among them, criticisms abound. The Babylonian Review issued a warning that the author's observation of the Apollo Star was fatally inaccurate.
Self-driving tourists can easily get lost in the Gorgon Current backwash if they do not correct their direction by 3.14° on the Ford Sextant Model T.
Time for late-night news ...

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: What ...

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: End of the 20th century ... Voice of the Millennium ...

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: Is this radio broadcasting news in 1999?
*crash sound*
The ritual from afar interrupts the broadcast.

items.speaker: Ms. Moissan
items.text: Just as I suspected.
She puts away her usual smile, the glowing light of a spell gathering at her fingertips.

items.speaker: Ms. Moissan
items.text: Since Timekeeper hasn't reported the time of this era to the Foundation ...

items.speaker: Ms. Moissan
items.text: You two, as the Foundation's investigators, shouldn't have known what year this is.
In front of her, the fog parts, revealing two familiar figures.

items.speaker: The Manus Believer
items.text: BLEEHHAA!!

items.speaker: Ms. Moissan
items.text: In such pouring rain, time is the best proof of identity.

items.speaker: Lilya
items.text: Hah, I get it. Not a bad plot.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: Ms. Moissan, watch your six! Let us help you!

items.speaker: The Manus Believer
items.text: BLEEHHAA!!
When the fog is cleared, the enemies are gone.
There's nothing else to be seen in the valley except for the supply boxes scattered on the ground.

items.speaker: Regulus
items.text: Tsk, didn't expect them to be clever enough to disguise themselves as the Foundation's investigators. They sure have learnt a thing or two.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: The "era" of 1929 only lasted for two days. The frequent change of time muddles work and responsibilities in the Foundation, which in turn caused some chaos within it.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: Luckily, Ms. Moissan noticed the signs of it at the beginning.

items.speaker: Ms. Moissan
items.text: Timekeeper, please take a look at this box.

items.speaker: Ms. Moissan
items.text: I'm afraid this is what they came here for.
Ms. Moissan turns aside, revealing the newly opened supply box in front of her.
Unlike the long-abandoned Laplace instruments, it is not yet soaked by the rain and mist here.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: This is ...

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: The Manus mask they used to stay immune to the "Storm"?!
TO BE CONTINUED…
